summary: Sorts the AI builds into two groups, work and fun, and gives each a short code and its media.
purpose: Feeds the AI builds vault: which builds show, in what order, which group they sit in, and what screens and videos they have.
why: The header comment says work builds came from job problems and fun builds were made for enjoyment. Career OS is kept with the curiosities.
how: 1) Keeps a fixed order list of build slugs. 2) Looks each slug up in the project data. 3) Places builds in the fun group if they are in a fixed set; all others go to the work group. 4) Gives each a code such as B01 or F14 from its position. 5) Attaches screenshots and videos. 6) Exposes the two group names and descriptions.
inputs: The project data, the media registry, the order list and the fun set.
outputs: The vault build list and the wing list.
risks: The order and fun set are typed by hand. A mistyped slug drops that build with no warning. Codes come from position, so reordering renumbers every build after the change.
debug: If a build is missing, check its slug in the order list matches the project slug exactly. If codes changed, a reorder renumbered them; this is expected.
